avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce metabolic pathways and reduce lacosamide efficacy; potential for breakthrough seizures
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; if necessary, obtain serum levels and adjust dose under close monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical risk of additive anticonvulsant effects and increased CNS depression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation and dizziness

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate CNS depressant effects, increasing sedation and dizziness
caution_supplements.action: Counsel patient on additive CNS effects; monitor for excessive drowsiness

caution_supplements.name: Kava kava
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Advise cautious use; monitor for increased sedation and liver function

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may worsen dizziness, ataxia, and cognitive impairment; increases seizure risk
caution_foods.action: Counsel strict alcohol avoidance; educate patient on increased fall and seizure risk

monitoring_notes: Lacosamide undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism, reducing drug-drug interaction risk. Monitor for CNS-related adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia) when used with other sedating agents; renal function assessment recommended given 40% renal excretion.
